project.name: 电商运营工具箱 - Apple 设计
project.designRead: desktop dashboard app / internal ops users / calm editorial / information-dense / no generic gradient hero
project.designDecisionSummary: Apple HIG-inspired dark dashboard with Pinguo Blue #0066cc accent, DM Sans type, 1.2rem radius, whisper-light shadows, frosted glass surfaces, dark sidebar. Restraint mode: borders before shadows, max two hues per page.

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: Pinguo Blue #0066cc primary, Space Black #0a0a0a backgrounds, Silver Mist #f5f5f7 light surfaces, Ink Gray #3a3a3c secondary text
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: 1.2rem global radius, pill buttons, 8px small controls, 12px cards
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: DM Sans for all interface, JetBrains Mono for technical data, 72-96px hero at 600 weight, 14-16px body at 400
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: border-defined cards, capsule buttons, subtle focus rings, frosted glass panels
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: border-first, 1px borders, whisper shadows, backdrop-filter blur for overlays
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: subtle brightness shift on hover, smooth cubic-bezier transitions
